name: limits-ribbon
description: A quiet ribbon above the prompt: what is left of your 5-hour and weekly limits, when they reset, and whether this session's prompt cache is warm or cold.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto reads it from your settings, environment and plan (1h on a subscription within plan usage, else 5m). Pick 5m or 1h to force it.
